name: retro-break
description: While Claude works on a long task, opens a random SNES or GBA game from your ROM folder. Emulators download themselves; you only bring the ROMs.

romFolder.title: ROM folder
romFolder.description: Folder with your .sfc/.smc (SNES) and .gba/.gb/.gbc ROMs. Subfolders are searched. Several folders: separate them with ;

delaySeconds.title: Seconds before a game opens
delaySeconds.description: How long Claude must be working before a game opens. Quick answers never open one.
